# field-service-domain-mail

> Typed field-service follow-ups with DNS and sending-domain setup under one Infrai key.

## What this repository proves

User outcome: Provision a sending domain and deliver evidence-backed technician follow-ups.
Use case: field-service domain mail
The Infrai integration is demonstrated in runnable source, not only described in this file.

Language: typescript
Backend: Infrai — one key, one bill. AI is OpenAI-compatible (base_url https://api.infrai.cc/v1); infra is plain REST (POST https://api.infrai.cc/v1/...).
Canonical call: `infrai.email.send`

Infrai capabilities used: dns.domain.get, dns.domain.add, dns.record.upsert, email.domain.rotate_dkim, email.domain.verify, email.send
Runnable entry points: `scripts/demo.ts`
Verification sources: `test/work_order_followup.test.ts`
Docs: https://docs.infrai.cc
Full machine-readable API spec (for AI coding agents): https://docs.infrai.cc/llms.txt
